title: Staircase mechanical energy growth in optomechanical systems of median mechanical frequencies
summary: Owing to the radiation-force-induced nonlinearity, cavity optomechanical systems (COMS) exhibit dynamical phenomena such as back-action induced oscillation, chaos, mechanical amplitude locking, and anomalous stabilization, which occur under different driving conditions and different system parameters.
